summary: Verified SiteSearch useCallback fix (Vercel build error) end-to-end on live preview. All search flows (icon click open, typing, results, highlight styling, arrow nav, Enter-to-navigate, recents persistence, '/' shortcut, Ctrl+K shortcut, recent click refills input, Esc close) work correctly with zero console errors. Admin search regression also verified.
critical_code_review_comments: SiteSearch.js commitNavigation correctly wrapped in useCallback with deps [query, navigate, onClose] (line 105-109); keydown useEffect deps include commitNavigation (line 124). Implementation is correct and CRA's exhaustive-deps will now pass.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SiteSearch modal flow verified: opens via nav-search-btn, '/' shortcut, and Ctrl+K. Query 'forklift' returns 2 results, Highlight component renders span with font-semibold + #C9A84C/30 color (verified in DOM). ArrowDown/ArrowUp correctly toggles aria-selected between result-0 and result-1. Enter navigates to /forklift-compliance-review-nc and persists 'forklift' to localStorage gl_search_recent. Reopening shows recents panel; clicking recent refills input. Esc closes modal. Admin search at /admin: 'test' filter on Intake Submissions reduced rows 11 -> 4; admin-search-clear restores to 11.
rca of the issue: Original build error was CRA react-hooks/exhaustive-deps. Fix: commitNavigation memoized via useCallback and added to keydown useEffect deps. Runtime behavior unchanged. Verified live: zero console errors during full flow; all 9 search-flow steps and admin-search regression pass.
